dav_cert_verification.description: Whether to verify WebDAV server certificates over HTTPS. Disable only for testing or with self-signed certs (not recommended in production).

dav_ca_cert_file.description: Path to a custom CA certificate bundle file (PEM format). If empty, system defaults are used.

dav_client_cert.description: Path to a client certificate (PEM format). Required only if the server requires mutual TLS authentication.

dav_client_key.description: Path to the private key for the client certificate. Required if client_cert is set.

dav_compression.description: Enable HTTP compression (gzip) for uploads. May improve performance over slow links but can increase CPU usage.

dav_cache_timeout.description: Time in seconds before cached metadata is considered stale. Lower values reduce consistency but improve freshness.

dav_max_conns.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections per WebDAV server. Increase for better throughput on high-latency links.

dav_cache_size_kb.description: Minimum free space (KB) to maintain on the cache directory. When free space drops below this, davfs2 will purge old cached content.

dav_cache_dir.description: Local directory for file content caching. Set to '' (empty string) to disable caching entirely (read-only fallback only).

dav_use_mmap.description: Use memory-mapped I/O for cached files (improves performance). Disable only if compatibility issues arise.

dav_use_locks.description: Enable WebDAV file locking. Disable if the server does not support locking or causes hangs.

dav_keep_alive.description: Use HTTP/1.1 persistent connections to reduce handshake overhead. Generally safe to enable.

dav_file_mode.description: Octal file permissions for newly created files (e.g., '0644', '0600').

dav_dir_mode.description: Octal permissions for newly created directories (e.g., '0755', '0700').

dav_cache_owner.description: User (name or UID) to own cache files and directories. Must have read/write access to cache_dir.

dav_cache_group.description: Group (name or GID) to own cache files and directories.

dav_extra_headers.description: List of custom HTTP headers to add to every WebDAV request. Useful for auth proxies or vendor-specific features.

dav_proxy.description: Proxy server in 'host:port' format (e.g., 'proxy.example.com:3128'). Leave blank to connect directly.

dav_debug.description: Enable debug logging (requires restart to take effect).
